fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Deploy NAS security mode extension (SME) to enforce stronger integrity protection.
Enable IMSI concealment (IMSI masking) in NAS signaling to prevent exposure.
Configure NAS rejection cause for invalid IMSI or unauthorized service requests.
Implement NAS replay attack detection with sequence number validation.
Set NAS timer T3450 (NAS inactivity) to 30 seconds for faster disconnection.
Enforce NAS security algorithm selection (e.g., 128-bit AES) via NAS security mode.
Deploy RAN-based IMSI filtering to block suspicious IMSI ranges.
Monitor NAS-EMM cause values for abnormal attachment attempts (e.g., 125).
Trigger automated RAN isolation for devices with repeated NAS anomalies.
Update NAS security configuration to disable legacy algorithms (e.g., SNOW 3G).

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
